move.subject: Re: Quote from Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for the time your team has put into it.
Thank you for your offer and for your enthusiasm about building a long-term relationship with us. We understand that you are fully booked and that a firm commitment matters; our order volume is fixed and represents our full demand for this part over the term, all with you. Would this committed volume allow you to improve the offer?

We confirm a binding volume of 4200 units a year for the 24-month term, our full demand for this part, all placed with you.

Electricity producer prices changed -6.1% from 2025-11 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-11, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).
The 1.4404 alloy surcharge changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).
Producer prices for cold-drawn bars changed -2.3% from 2026-06 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-06, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).

On this basis we propose: EUR 30.51 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 42 days, for our full demand of 4200 units a year over 24 months.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.text:

Hi, thanks for the volume confirmation and the index numbers, we checked them and they do help a bit.
42 days lead time is super tight for us right now, but with 14 days payment we can make it work.
We can drop the price to €31.00 per unit for this package.
Which volume can you commit to?
Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C2431, AS-14404, PPI-D351.
Our standard Zahlungsziel is 45 days net.
Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price.
We really want this business - let's make it happen!
Kind regards
Jana Procházková
Export Manager, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.
